Container.Name: hytale-server
Container.Overview:
A dedicated server for Hytale. The server files are downloaded and updated with the official Hytale Downloader.
First start: you must sign in with your Hytale account. Open the container log, go to the URL that it shows, and sign in. When the server has started, the log shows a second link. Open it and authorize again.
Requirements: 4 CPU cores, 4 GB RAM (8 GB recommended), 10 GB storage. View distance has the largest effect on RAM use. Set MAX_MEMORY to match the RAM you give the server.
Hytale uses QUIC over UDP. Forward UDP port 5520 on your router. If you change the port, also change DEFAULT_PORT.
To install mods, put .jar or .zip files in the mods folder of the server files and restart the container.
Docker image by indifferentbroccoli.

Config.Name: Game Port
Config.Description: UDP game port (QUIC). Forward it on your router. Must be the same as DEFAULT_PORT.

Config.Name: Server Files
Config.Description: Server files, worlds, mods, config, backups, and saved authentication.

Config.Name: Server Name
Config.Description: Name of the server.

Config.Name: Max Players
Config.Description: Maximum number of players on the server.

Config.Name: View Distance
Config.Description: View distance in chunks. 12 chunks is 384 blocks. Higher values need more RAM.

Config.Name: Max Memory
Config.Description: Maximum Java heap size, for example 8G or 8192M. Include the unit.

Config.Name: Enable Backups
Config.Description: Make automatic world backups (true or false).

Config.Name: Backup Frequency
Config.Description: Minutes between backups, when backups are on.

Config.Name: Backup Max Count
Config.Description: Number of backups to keep.

Config.Name: Min Memory
Config.Description: Minimum Java heap size, for example 4G. Leave empty to not set a minimum.

Config.Name: JVM Arguments
Config.Description: Optional extra Java arguments, for example -XX:+UseG1GC.

Config.Name: Auth Mode
Config.Description: authenticated or offline. Use offline only for testing, because it lets players join without authentication.

Config.Name: Auth Select Profile
Config.Description: Profile number to authenticate the server with, if your account has more than one profile.

Config.Name: Patchline
Config.Description: Game patchline: release or pre-release.

Config.Name: Download On Start
Config.Description: Download and update the server files on each start. Set to false to skip.

Config.Name: Default Port
Config.Description: UDP port the server listens on. Must be the same as the Game Port.

Config.Name: Backup Directory
Config.Description: Folder in the container for backups. Keep it inside /home/hytale/server-files so backups persist.

Config.Name: Use AOT Cache
Config.Description: Use the ahead-of-time compilation cache for a faster start.

Config.Name: Accept Early Plugins
Config.Description: Allow early plugins. These can make the server unstable.

Config.Name: Disable Sentry
Config.Description: Turn off Sentry crash reporting.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID for file permissions.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID for file permissions.
